gates.evidence: The proposal introduces 'Premium' scenarios but fails to explicitly guarantee they will be SFW-compliant. Given the platform is an AI roleplay site with potentially adult content, this risks placing ads on non-compliant, unsafe inventory, violating [SAFE-1].
The proposal uses a standard rewarded ad for content access; no clicks, installs, or cash-like rewards are offered.
The proposal uses a gain-framing approach (unlocking exclusive content) rather than a loss-framing one.
The offer requires the user to tap 'Play Now' after disclosure.
The offer clearly states the reward (72-hour access) and action (play 15-second game).
The offer includes a clear 'No thanks' button that closes the prompt without penalty.
The offer is placed on the Character Details screen (s09), which is static, not mid-conversation.
The proposal explicitly excludes subscribers via the 'Non-subscribers only' eligibility rule.

scores.evidence: The trigger occurs exactly when a user is evaluating a scenario they wish to access, making it highly contextually relevant.
The integration is native to the existing character details screen and creates a new content tier without degrading the free experience.
The reward is time-boxed to 72 hours, capped at 3 per day, and explicitly gated to non-subscribers.
Cost to serve is zero, and revenue is net-positive compared to zero-ad baseline.
Character details are a core part of the exploration loop, ensuring high exposure.
Maps directly to existing SIM-RWD implementation with a standard button entry.
Uses specific app nouns like 'Willson Wáng' and targets the Character Details screen (s09).
Includes a strict daily cap of 3 and a 60-minute cooldown.
Includes a primary metric (scenario unlocks), guardrails, and a 10% holdout plan.

requiredChanges: Explicitly restrict 'Premium' scenarios to SFW-rated content that passes content moderation for brand safety, in accordance with the brand-safety requirements in [SAFE-1].
Correct the 'JanitorPlus' resource name to 'Janitor Plus' in the edge guard to match the actual subscription resource name.
parsed.topConcern: The proposal lacks explicit brand-safety guardrails for the new 'Premium' scenario content type, which could result in rewarded ads being shown alongside non-compliant or adult content.
